title: A tag that names code to run is kept as a tag or refused, and nothing is constructed
notes: Section 3.3 lets a processor treat an unrecognised tag as a load failure, so an error is conformant (category unresolved-tag); a library that loads the document must keep the node with its tag and must not interpret it. Readers that construct objects from such tags let a document execute code. The time and memory bounds are the kit's robustness requirement, not a rule of the specification.

provenance.reference: CVE-2017-18342: PyYAML load() constructed arbitrary Python objects from python/ tags
